nodes.label: graphify-out Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Dirty graphify-out/ files are expected after hooks or incremental updates and are not a reason to skip graphify; only skip when the task is about stale/incorrect graph output or the user explicitly says not to use it.

nodes.label: graphify query/path/explain Tools
nodes.rationale: These return a scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so prefer them for codebase questions.

nodes.label: graphify update Command
nodes.rationale: Run after modifying code to keep the graph current; it is AST-only with no API cost.

nodes.label: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Read only for broad architecture review or when query/path/explain do not surface enough context.
